name: avx2
description: AVX2/FMA math across four threads, checked against scalar code (needs guest.cpu v3).

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
if [ "$i" = 0 ]; then
  { grep -m1 '^flags' /proc/cpuinfo
    dmesg | grep 'x86/fpu'
    /nix/store/dbcw19dshdwnxdv5q2g6wldj6syyvq7l-glibc-2.39-52/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 --help | grep 'x86-64-v'
  } 2>&1 | sed 's/^/hydo-avx-cpu: /' > /dev/ttyS0
fi
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  out=$(/bin/hydoavx $i)
  if [ $? = 0 ]; then echo "$out" >> /data/avx/out; sync; echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; fi
  echo "hydo-avx: $out" > /dev/ttyS0
  i=$((i + 1))
done

invariants.msg: every hydoavx run had AVX2 + FMA and its vector results equal the scalar ones
invariants.cmd:
n=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED)
good=$(grep -c ' avx2=1 ok=1 ' /data/avx/out 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$n" = 8 ] && [ "${good:-0}" -ge "$n" ]; then echo "steps=$n all AVX2 results equal the scalar ones"; exit 0; fi
echo "acked=$n good=${good:-0}"; exit 1

invariants.msg: the guest kernel sees AVX2 and uses XSAVE with x87|SSE|AVX
